basis: Renal ciliopathy; structural biliary disease with intrahepatic duct dilatation in 6/6 and hepatic cysts in 1/2; pancreatic cysts only 1/6.
MHC-I immunodeficiency; chronic sinusitis and bronchitis in 3/3, bronchiectasis in 1/1. Recurrent GI infection alone does not establish lasting GI damage.
T-lineage lymphoblast malignancy involving blood/marrow or lymphoid tissues; lymphoma warrants the immune mechanism axis.
Autoinflammatory interferonopathy encompassing Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 3, whose defining phenotype includes encephalopathy; other organ frequencies are unestablished.
PDHX-related metabolic disease defined by lactic acidosis and neurologic dysfunction; frequent seizures, spastic paresis and corpus callosum abnormalities.
Purine nucleotide metabolic enzyme deficiency; erythrocyte biochemical abnormalities alone do not establish blood-cell damage.
Premature activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal endocrine axis; no structural neurologic disease is established.
Carcinoma originating in reproductive ovarian epithelium; metastatic sites are separate secondary malignancies, not organ labels for the primary.
Mitochondrial myopathy with diabetes; pyramidal dysfunction supported by lower-limb hyperreflexia in 30-79% and Babinski sign in 1/1; axonal neuropathy only 5-29%.
Defining severe limb and pelvic skeletal malformations; nail dysplasia in 80-99%. Reproductive malformations have no axis.
Combined deficiency of coagulation factors VIII and IX; no evidence establishes common direct injury to additional organs.
Fibrinolytic bleeding disorder; joint hemorrhage 80-99%, muscle hematomas and hemothorax 30-79%. Hematuria alone does not establish urinary-organ injury.
Defined by immunodeficiency and persistent livedo/telangiectatic skin findings. Bronchiectasis occurs in only 2/14; short stature alone does not establish bone disease.
Congenital neuronal migration disorder with periventricular nodular heterotopia; no additional organ disease is established.
Isolated cortical malformation with developmental impairment and seizures; feeding difficulty does not establish intrinsic gastrointestinal injury.
Biallelic RDH12-related retinal degeneration; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis despite the neurological ancestor.
Multiple congenital skeletal fusions and symphalangism; hearing involvement is not established for this subtype.
Umbrella for strongylid nematode infections; the definition does not establish a consistently damaged organ across the group.
Mutilating keratoderma; ankylosis 80-99%, dental abnormalities/hypodontia and sensorineural hearing impairment 30-79%. Osteolysis is only 5-29%.
Lymphatic vascular neoplasm; lung/pleural involvement 80-99%, consumptive hypofibrinogenemia and osteolysis 30-79%. Four-axis cap reached.
Defining neurodevelopmental and limb skeletal defects; primary hypothyroidism and urethral malformation (hypospadias) each 30-79%. Other genital anomalies lack an axis.
Soft-tissue sarcoma arising in limb connective tissues, commonly dermis/subcutis and tendon-associated fascia; no common additional organ injury established.
Benign smooth-muscle tumor arising in the pericardium; site of origin determines the axis.
Predominantly reproductive gonadal germ-cell carcinoma; CNS origin is a minority site-specific subtype, and mediastinal location does not establish lung origin.
Carcinoma of the endometrium in the uterine body, a reproductive organ outside the available axes.
